top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 1,619 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the three-day window were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The scripts found 1,619 requests for additional information and Form 99 filings received since November 3, 2026, and every one of them was already reported in a prior edition. Nothing new is waiting for this edition.

The deterministic extras found nothing to add: no deadline findings, no new $1 million-plus gifts, no new independent expenditures of $50,000 or more, and no notable refunds, forfeitures, investments or former-member spending in the Schedule B data that loaded.

footer.coverage_window: FEC RFAI (FRQ) and Form 99 filings received November 3, 2026 onward, as of the Friday, November 6, 2026 PM edition. No voided or negative transactions of $10,000 or more were new.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
footer.known_gaps: The Schedule A fetch for voided and negative transactions failed with an HTTP 504 (query timed out), so voided or negative contributions of $10,000 or more may be missing from this edition. The Money Out check of Schedule B for Trump properties ('Trump National') also failed with an HTTP 504, so that part of the spending review did not run.

apod.title: A Farewell to Swift
apod.caption: It is time to say goodbye to NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory. After nearly 22 years of service, the satellite re-entered Earth's atmosphere on November 4 at 7:39 EST over the North Sumatra region of Indonesia.
